title: Coachella 2027: Big Stars to Headline
summary: Coachella has announced its 2027 headliners. Dua Lipa, Tame Impala, and SZA will top the bill at the big music festival in California. The news came after SZA teased the headliners on social media. Daddy Yankee gets his own special slot, and Justice will debut a song called 'Blinded by the Lights.' More big names are on the list. Madonna returns to the Dance Tent. Phoebe Bridgers, Don Toliver, Zara Larsson, Weezer, Dom Dolla, Kygo, Empire of the Sun, and Role Model are also near the top. Also on the poster are Kehlani, Jisoo, Tiesto, Maneskin, Four Tet, Becky G, and many more. The festival takes place at the Empire Polo Club in Indio, California. It runs for two weekends: April 9-11 and April 16-18, 2027. Passes go on sale November 13 at 12 p.m. PT on the festival's website. YouTube will livestream the shows for fans who cannot attend. Last year, Coachella had headlining sets from Sabrina Carpenter, Justin Bieber, Karol G, and Anyma. Madonna even surprised fans during Carpenter's set.
why_it_matters: Music festivals bring fans together to enjoy the songs they love, and watching the shows can make you feel part of something big.
